description: Figure 3 presents a bar chart illustrating the conceptualized and operationalized targets by year, alongside the distribution of datasets. The horizontal axis represents the years from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis, labeled “Number of datasets,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The chart displays grouped bars for each year, where each group contains two bars: a blue bar representing datasets with “1” target (i.e., explicitly mentioning at least one target in their construct definition) and an orange bar representing datasets with “2+” targets. The height of each bar corresponds to the number of datasets for that category in that year. For example, in 2021, the blue bar reaches approximately 100, indicating 100 datasets with one target, while the orange bar reaches approximately 45, indicating 45 datasets with two or more targets. The bars are not sorted and are presented chronologically by year. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
